thread:
leah: Quick proposal — run a small private-offer experiment across Azure + GCP to measure committed-conversion lift. 3 discount tiers: 10%, 20%, 30%. Keep it small and instrumented.

omar: Sounds good. Segment by deal size: micro (<$25k), mid ($25k-250k), enterprise (>$250k). Also separate hosted vs dedicated SKUs.

sudeep: Add appliance SKU for hardware partner signal. We need to make sure billing flow is clear (invoiced vs metered).

anna: Metrics: 90-day commit conversion, 12m renewal rate, CAC by channel. Dashboard to show cohort + region (us, eu, apac).

leah: Success guardrails: prefer 15%+ conversion uplift OR 7%+ ARR delta. If not, revert higher discounts.

david: Who creates offers? marketplace-bot can stage them but legal approval required for >25% discounts. Also Sales Ops must tag test leads.

marketplace-bot: I can stage sandbox offers. Example command: `/mp create-offer --cloud azure --sku "hosted-pro" --discount 20 --cohort mid --test`

omar: Timeline: prep this week, launch 6 weeks, then 2-week analysis. Need partner comms for hw bundle — @sudeep lead?

sudeep: I will draft a partner note + SI reward: 2.5% referral credit on first renewal for partners that refer commit deals. Sharing draft tomorrow.

anna: Also include renewal nudge at month 10 for enterprise cohort to measure elasticity on renewal timing.

leah: I'll take Legal + PMM sync. Also add region tag sampling so we don't bias toward us-west pricing sensitivity.

david: Sales Ops will add attribution tag (marketplace vs direct). We'll track CAC and sales cycle length. Note: appliance SKUs require separate invoicing flows — can complicate attribution.

omar: Keep the experiment narrow: randomize SI partners (strategic vs transactional) across cohorts so partner quality doesn't skew results.

leah: Next actions: Sudeep partner note, Omar orchestration plan, Anna dashboard spec, David Sales Ops tagging, me legal signoff. Will post Asana task by EOD Friday.

omar: :thumbsup: one more — capture renewal cadence sensitivity (offer renewal window at 9, 10, 11 months) for enterprise deals to see if earlier nudges improve retention.

sudeep: noted. will include in partner doc.

leah: Thanks all — short, measurable experiment. Back here when Asana link is up.
